title: EndgamePlus
description: Endgame progression and quality-of-life enhancements for Paper servers.
body:
EndgamePlus

EndgamePlus is a vanilla-friendly endgame expansion for Paper servers.

It introduces late-game progression, rare relic loot, and quality-of-life improvements without breaking early-game balance.
All features are configurable and designed to feel like a natural extension of Minecraft rather than a modded overhaul.

🔮 Ancient City Endgame Progression

Rare Unbreaking X enchanted book with a 1% chance per Ancient City chest

Firework celebration when the relic is discovered

Daily loot reset for Ancient City chests

Optional respawn of destroyed Ancient City chests

Ancient Cities become meaningful endgame content instead of one-time loot structures.

⚒ Advanced Anvil Mechanics

Combine Efficiency books beyond vanilla limits (Efficiency VI–X)

Apply high-level Efficiency safely to pickaxes

Remove the vanilla “Too Expensive” anvil restriction

Free item renaming without XP cost

Allow normally incompatible enchantments such as Infinity + Mending

All anvil behavior is configurable and respects vanilla balance where possible.

🧰 Tool Enhancements

Silk Touch on shears for:

Leaves

Vines

Glow lichen

Fortune on shears for bonus drops:

Wool

Honeycombs

Fortune on hoes affecting seed drops only

These changes enhance tools without affecting block drops or automation balance.

🌱 World Regeneration and Maintenance

Daily reset of tracked:

Sculk sensors

Sculk shriekers

Sculk catalysts

Manual admin reset commands for full control

Reset logic only affects tracked locations, preventing abuse or farming exploits

🛠 Commands
/endgameplus reset loot
/endgameplus reset sculk
/endgameplus reset all

🔐 Permissions

endgameplus.admin
Grants access to administrative reset commands

⚙ Configuration

All features can be enabled, disabled, or tuned via config.yml, including:

Loot chances

Reset behavior

Anvil rules

Tool enhancements

Firework celebrations

✅ Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21.11

Paper servers only
